text:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer
We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to build and operate recommendation and ranking systems. You will productionize models, partner with product teams, and improve model quality at scale.
Requirements:
- 5+ years building machine learning systems
- Strong Python and SQL
- Production experience with PyTorch and Docker
- Experience with AWS and Kubernetes

Computer Vision Engineer
Our perception team is hiring a Computer Vision Engineer to develop real-time image understanding for autonomous devices. The role covers data pipelines, model training, and deployment to edge hardware.
What you bring:
- Python and C++
- OpenCV and computer vision fundamentals
- Deep learning with TensorFlow
- Experience with NVIDIA CUDA and Linux

Natural Language Processing Engineer
Join our language intelligence group as an NLP Engineer. You will train and evaluate large language models, build retrieval-augmented generation services, and turn research prototypes into reliable APIs.
Required skills:
- Python and PyTorch
- Hugging Face Transformers
- NLP and transformer architectures
- Experience with REST APIs and Git

MLOps Engineer
We need an MLOps Engineer to make model delivery repeatable and observable. You will own training and serving infrastructure, CI/CD for machine learning, and monitoring for data and model drift.
Key qualifications:
- Python and Bash
- Kubernetes and Docker
- Terraform and GitHub Actions
- MLflow and Prometheus
- Experience with Google Cloud Platform

Generative AI Engineer
A research-driven product team is seeking a Generative AI Engineer to ship assistants powered by foundation models. You will design prompt and evaluation pipelines, fine-tune models, and build safe, scalable inference services.
Qualifications:
- Python and JavaScript
- OpenAI API and LangChain
- Retrieval-augmented generation and vector databases
- Experience with fine-tuning and LLM evaluation
- FastAPI and PostgreSQL
